I am Mama Nkoyo from Delta State. This my small plot of 0.26 hectares na cassava I dey plant here since the land belong to another person and I no fit put too much money for rented land. I go use the chicken manure wey I get for house and buy small NPK fertilizer from the market, but I no go waste money on chemical spray or irrigation because rain dey fall well for our side. My children go help me work the land and I go pay two young boys for few days to help with the heavy clearing and digging.
